DO $$
DECLARE
    constraint_record RECORD;
BEGIN
    FOR constraint_record IN
        SELECT
            constraint_name
        FROM information_schema.table_constraints
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'human_handoff_tasks'
          AND constraint_type = 'CHECK'
    LOOP
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM pg_constraint constraint_item
            INNER JOIN pg_class relation
                ON relation.oid = constraint_item.conrelid
            WHERE relation.relname = 'human_handoff_tasks'
              AND constraint_item.conname =
                  constraint_record.constraint_name
              AND pg_get_constraintdef(
                    constraint_item.oid
                  ) ILIKE '%source_type%'
        ) THEN
            EXECUTE FORMAT(
                'ALTER TABLE human_handoff_tasks DROP CONSTRAINT %I',
                constraint_record.constraint_name
            );
        END IF;
    END LOOP;
END
$$;

ALTER TABLE human_handoff_tasks
    ADD CONSTRAINT human_handoff_tasks_source_type_check
    CHECK (
        source_type IN (
            'appointment_confirmation',
            'disruption_case',
            'waitlist_offer',
            'appointment',
            'medication_case',
            'insurance_case',
            'feedback_case',
            'manual'
        )
    );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_feedback_cases (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    patient_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES patients(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    appointment_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES appointments(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    feedback_type TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            feedback_type IN (
                'complaint',
                'suggestion',
                'praise',
                'service_feedback',
                'other'
            )
        ),

    category TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            category IN (
                'reception',
                'appointment',
                'doctor',
                'nursing',
                'medication',
                'billing_insurance',
                'facility',
                'communication',
                'privacy',
                'other'
            )
        ),

    rating_overall INTEGER
        CHECK (
            rating_overall IS NULL
            OR rating_overall BETWEEN 1 AND 5
        ),

    feedback_message TEXT NOT NULL,

    has_safety_concern BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    has_privacy_concern BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    has_financial_dispute BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    staff_misconduct_reported BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    wants_response BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    consent_to_contact BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    source_channel TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'whatsapp'
        CHECK (
            source_channel IN (
                'whatsapp',
                'sms',
                'phone',
                'telegram',
                'web',
                'manual'
            )
        ),

    priority TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'low'
        CHECK (
            priority IN (
                'low',
                'normal',
                'high',
                'urgent'
            )
        ),

    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new'
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'new',
                'in_review',
                'awaiting_patient',
                'escalated',
                'resolved',
                'closed'
            )
        ),

    needs_human_review BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    handoff_task_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES human_handoff_tasks(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    assigned_to TEXT,
    response_to_patient TEXT,
    resolution_note TEXT,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_feedback_cases_active
    ON patient_feedback_cases(
        status,
        priority,
        created_at
    )
    WHERE status IN (
        'new',
        'in_review',
        'awaiting_patient',
        'escalated'
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_feedback_cases_patient
    ON patient_feedback_cases(
        patient_id,
        created_at DESC
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_feedback_cases_appointment
    ON patient_feedback_cases(
        appointment_id,
        created_at DESC
    )
    WHERE appointment_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_feedback_cases_category
    ON patient_feedback_cases(
        category,
        feedback_type,
        created_at DESC
    );

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,
    'migration_completed' AS result,
    'ساختار ثبت و رسیدگی به شکایت، نظر و رضایت بیمار ایجاد شد.' AS message;

parameters.content:
## فقط یک‌بار اجرا شود

این Workflow جدول `patient_feedback_cases` را ایجاد می‌کند و `feedback_case` را به منابع صف انسانی اضافه می‌کند.

ساختار برای شکایت، پیشنهاد، تشکر، امتیاز رضایت، نگرانی ایمنی، حریم خصوصی و اختلاف مالی است.
